column1: # Decompiled functions of Chibi-Robo! (stage 2): one line per function, read by tools/decomp_functions.py and
# tools/build.py. Names, addresses and sizes only: no game data.
#   name      identifier of the export record in the decompiled code (GC_DECOMP_EXPORT); one line per name
#   module    "dol" for main.dol, or the REL file name without extension (e.g. stage01) for a REL module
#   us_addr   GGTE01: guest address (dol), or offset in the module's first code section (REL, as in the dtk
#   pal_addr  GGTP01: same; "-" if not known yet. A function without an address in BOTH versions cannot be enabled
#   size      size in bytes of the original function: must be its size in BOTH versions (one column only, so a
#             function whose size differs between versions cannot be enabled yet)
#   status    disabled   = listed, not built (no hook, no registration; a source file whose functions are all
#                          disabled is not compiled either, tools/build.py)
#             unverified = replaces its recompiled version, has NOT passed the oracle's promotion rule
#             verified   = replaces it and passed the promotion rule of tools/decomp_oracle.py in every version: no
#                          difference on every compared call of the reference scenarios and on every synthetic case
#                          (decomp/oracle_cases/), every basic block of the original reachable from its entry
#                          exercised by them, at least 10 distinct real starting states or saturated after 1000
#                          comparisons (thresholds: hypothesis), no call left uncompared, the oracle at its default
#                          settings, accidental copies of a run refused (forged results are out of scope: nothing is
#                          signed). Basic-block coverage (not edge or path coverage), not a proof on states never
#             (compared whole and case-insensitive, as tools/decomp_progress.py does; any other status refuses the table)
#   pal_oracle  optional column: "yes" once the oracle has passed on GGTP01; "no", "-" or empty otherwise
# The oracle does not compare FPSCR (runtime/core/decomp/gc_oracle_compare.h). This holds for this game because its
# own code never reads or writes FPSCR: no mffs, mtfsf, mtfsfi, mtfsb0, mtfsb1 or mcrfs in the 16 RELs of either
# version, and those of the two DOLs (9 each) are all in the Nintendo and Metrowerks libraries, which are not
# Activation lock (tools/decomp_functions.py, run by tools/build.py; the build is refused otherwise). For an enabled
#   (a) a GGTP01 address that symbols/GGTP01-gaps.tsv places at the level position or sized is refused unless
#       pal_oracle is "yes"; only the levels strong and graph are enabled without it; any other level is refused;
#   (b) the size must equal the function's size in that version (GGTP01-gaps.tsv target size, otherwise the symbol
#       maps and symbols/GGTE01-to-GGTP01.tsv, the transposition report of tools/symbols.py, whose GGTE01 columns
#       list every GGTE01 function with its size), and the range must not hold another known function start of that
#   (c) an address that is in none of these sources is refused;
#   (d) pal_addr must be the address that GGTE01-to-GGTP01.tsv or GGTP01-gaps.tsv gives to the function at us_addr
#       (the same function in both versions); for a REL line, both <ID>-rel.tsv maps must give it the same name;
#   and the address must be the start of a function of that size in the DOL or REL of the version (the instruction
#   before it ends a function or is padding, the last one is blr/bctr/b).
